title: Enhanced biomass production from Chlorella micro-algae species: a review of new technologies towards sustainable energy development

Chlorella microalgae are photosynthetic plants that can metabolize organic and inorganic substrates. They provide sustainable feedstocks for biodiesel, biohydrogen, bioethanol and biogas production.
